title: Simran W NDE 3951/4966 NDE 4966
content:
4966 How can I describe this with words? The feeling is just so incredibly beautiful and miraculous for anyone to describe it. But it is so true, so loving, and so peaceful that I feel it has become a part of me. It was the sunny morning at around 11 pm on May 18, 2007. I boarded a bus to work in another city. I do not know what happened, all I can remember is hearing concerned voices around me all pleading with me lovingly, saying ‘Wake up!! Wake up!! Nothing will happen to you. Nothing will happen to your brain. You are a vipassaniya! Wake up, wake up! And woke up. I saw that the bus I was travelling on had been involved in a terrible accident, killing the bus driver and injuring many of us passengers. I was the only one who was flung from a front seat. My vision was blurred and the sound around me was dull. A man asked me if I wanted to inform a member of my family. I struggled to answer, but managed to give my husband’s name. Then I saw my blood soaked body covered with splinters. My leg was crushed badly. I fell unconscious. I opened my eyes, gasping for breath and saw myself amidst the doctors. I tried to make a sign to alert them to help me breathe saw the doctors and nurses cutting my clothes off. I tried to protect myself but gave up. Then a bright light appeared which had a soft male voice. It said ‘You will leave everything behind. Your loved ones, the hard-earned awards, money, even your clothes. You will come to me empty handed’. The light also gave me an important message and to remember it. My mother said I was unconscious for 3 days. My doctor and family told me I was in a near fatal condition due to my head injury. Anything could have happened to me from being left in a permanent vegetative state, to losing my memory or possible death. I smile because I was already informed by the angels. The accident rendered me disabled to this day. When people see me smiling, they wonder why I have a glow on my face. It is the glow of God. I feel very homesick and feel a sense of not belonging to this world. For I know this is not my home. I do not feel human. I have to live this life and obey the message until He calls me back. He only had love for me. It is very hard but I am trying my best to spread the LOVE and PEACE God has for all of us.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death' Blood loss, a skull fracture and other major injuries made it a life threatening event. | Yes Accident 'Life threatening event, but not clinical death' I was involved in an accident.
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: More consciousness and alertness than normal | Normal consciousness and alertness As above.
elements.At what time during the experience were: In the operating theatre. | I was kind of aware although I was completely unconscious.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.The experience included: Presence of deceased persons | Light | Strong emotional tone | Vision of the future | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes I saw the face of my deceased uncle and a friend who died at a young age. | Yes My deceased uncle and a close friend
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes A glow which had a soft male voice speaking to me and giving me a very important message | Yes God is light. It was soothing, calm, and loving. I felt that we are all a part of that light, including animals and insects.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm saw this beautiful glowing light | No
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I felt peaceful, loving, and caring. | Concern, loving, caring.
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future | Scenes from the world's future The angels said 'Nothing will happen to you, nothing will happen to your brain’. Three years later, I had severe attack of meningitis and face paralysis. I fought it and got well. I then recalled the message I had been given and realized what it meant.

elements.Have your religious practices changed si: No | Uncertain I have become very spiritual and believe God lives in each of us.
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: No | Uncertain I have become very spiritual and believe God lives in each of us.
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.During your experience, did you gain spe: Yes I believe there must be some purpose to my life and that is the reason I returned. | Yes I see life in everything and know that I am here for a purpose and that this is just one universe.
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes I forgive people. I inspire people. Also I have become less caring as I leave problems in the hands of God. | Yes I can communicate/relate more readily to every person I meet.

elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes Initially because of the high doses of medication and the injections I was not completely conscious for many months. Gradually, I started to feel that something happened to me and then came across an article in a magazine that introduced me to the technical term for my experience, an NDE. | No Not really.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: No | Yes I have become very spiritual and know when another soul is good.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Good, bad, divine, evil, peace, war. Everything has a reason.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes I shared it with my doctor. I told him that I felt like a soul. He said it must be because of the head injury. He believed me. | Yes Within a year, as soon as I could understand the experience myself. I told my husband, sister and doctor.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real Very meaningful. It was the best thing that had ever happened to me.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: No | Yes Heavy intravenous injections to fight the meningitis.
